advisor_identified: Jo Ann Ooiman Robinson, professor of history at Morgan State University.

doctorate.title: The Traveler from Zierkzee: The Religious, Intellectual and Political Development of A. J. Muste from 1885 to 1940

evidence.says: Graduate faculty listing (PDF page 354) identifies Jo Ann Robinson as a history professor, with a Knox BA and both MA and PhD from Johns Hopkins University.

Indexed text of the 1972 Johns Hopkins commencement program lists Jo Ann Oiman Robinson in History, with a Knox undergraduate degree and Johns Hopkins MA, followed by the exact dissertation title in the linked record.
Publisher biography identifies the historian as Jo Ann Ooiman Robinson of Morgan State University and credits her biography of A. J. Muste.

Page 15 records Dibua chairing John Wood’s dissertation defense on Wally and Juanita Nelson, peace, racial equality and social justice, 1935–1975, in Morgan State’s History Department in 2008, establishing the affiliation missing from the supplied student entry.

notes: Institution, year, subject and dissertation title match the linked record. The commencement index renders the middle name Oiman; the publisher gives Ooiman. The commencement evidence was available as indexed text; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403.
